final_answer.key_evidence_summary: Health-chain walk on namespace boutique: pod listing shows a single outlier row emailservice-77bbb89876-x85qb 0/1 Running (all other 10 pods 1/1), matching deployment emailservice 0/1 ready / 0 available while every peer deployment is 1/1. Pod describe gives the mechanism verbatim: kubelet 'Warning Unhealthy (x10 over 82s) Readiness probe failed: Get "http://172.20.2.91:8080/": net/http: HTTP/1.x transport connection broken: malformed HTTP response "\x00\x00\x1e\x04..."' — the response bytes are HTTP/2 gRPC frame headers, proving an HTTP/1.x probe hitting a gRPC port. Config confirmation: emailservice readinessProbe is httpGet path=/ port=8080 while the container's port 8080 is the gRPC port (its livenessProbe correctly uses grpc port=8080); peer gRPC service checkoutservice uses grpc probes for both readiness and liveness. Container shows Ready False, Restart Count 0, and emailservice logs show a healthy server ('starting the email service in dummy mode.', 'listening on port: 8080'), excluding OOMKilled/exit-code/app-code causes. Breakpoint = readiness probe protocol misuse on the gRPC service emailservice, so the pod never becomes Ready and its service unit stays in an abnormal recycle/not-ready state.
